name: You're Everyone's Sucker
source:
After years of blowing off everyone you know, you attend a house party and run into your old friend. If only your words would come out right.


It's a house party with a bit too many clowns and people you don't remember.

[From [url=https://through-the-window.itch.io/youre-everyones-sucker]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多年来，你与所有认识的人都疏远了，你参加了一个家庭聚会，并遇到了你的老朋友。要是你的话能说对就好了。


这是一个家庭聚会，有太多的小丑和你不记得的人。

[来自[url=https://through-the-window.itch.io/youre-everyones-sucker]itch.io[/url]]
